mapper.select: select cache_id, assistant_code, normalized_question, answer_text, source, hit_count, created_at, last_used_at, expired_at from ai_answer_cache where assistant_code = #{assistantCode} and normalized_question = #{normalizedQuestion} and (expired_at is null or expired_at > now()) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ai_answer_cache ( cache_id, assistant_code, normalized_question, answer_text, source, hit_count, created_at, last_used_at, expired_at ) values ( #{cacheId}, #{assistantCode}, #{normalizedQuestion}, #{answerText}, #{source}, #{hitCount}, #{createdAt}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{expiredAt} )
